resolution: Fixed Map Paint strokes being intercepted by the world placement surface. The native map-paint input guard now ignores the WorldViewport's own full-screen input catcher (testID editor-world-input) while still yielding to real UI chrome such as the paint dock, action bar, sliders, inputs, and scrollbars. The cart also defensively preempts world placement while mapPaint.active is true and hides the BuildBar under the MapPaintDock, so stale Place mode cannot eat paint strokes as drag-place gestures. Verified with zig build test-game-map, git diff --check on touched files, and SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship editor.
